trainingQA.question: Mere paas abhi Wholesale Drug License nahi hai, kya fir bhi PCD franchise start kar sakta hoon?
trainingQA.answer: Wholesale DL aur GST mandatory hota hai sir, lekin token dekar monopoly book kar sakte hain ya registered distributor ke DL pe billing karwa sakte hain.

trainingQA.question: Payment terms kya hain? Bilty copy pe payment chalegi ya advance?
trainingQA.answer: Shuru me 30% advance booking aur balance 70% Transport Bilty (LR) copy aane ke baad pay kar sakte hain sir. Udhar nahi ho pata.

trainingQA.question: Marketing kit me kya kya items milenge aur visual aid ka koi extra charge hai kya?
trainingQA.answer: Visual aid, MR bag, doctor samples aur reminder cards free milenge sir order ke sath. Konsi range me start karna chahte hain?

trainingQA.question: Third party manufacturing me packaging carton aur cylinder banane ka charge kitna lagega?
trainingQA.answer: 3D carton designing bilkul free provide karte hain sir, initial batch me sirf standard cylinder charges lagte hain.

trainingQA.question: Agar koi doosra chemist mere assigned district me directly order kare to kya hoga?
trainingQA.answer: Strict district monopoly policy hai sir. Aapke area ka koi bhi order ya inquiry aayegi to directly aapke through hi route hogi.
